faq.q: Which plan covers Chilliwack Proper East?
faq.a: The Chilliwack Proper and Fairfield Island Neighbourhoods Plan, which guides residential infill development and is now Schedule B2 of Official Community Plan Bylaw 2025, No. 5500; it was first added to the 2040 OCP as Schedule D through Bylaw 2018, No. 4533.

faq.q: Which schools are near Chilliwack Proper East?
faq.a: Bernard Elementary (45465 Bernard Ave), Robertson Elementary (46106 Southlands Cres) and Strathcona Elementary (46375 Strathcona Rd), all Kindergarten to Grade 5, plus Chilliwack Middle School (46354 Yale Rd, Grades 6 to 8) and Chilliwack Secondary (46363 Yale Rd, Grades 9 to 12) — names and addresses confirmed against the BC Ministry K-12 file; catchments are set by address, so confirm a specific address with the SD33 School Locator (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: Can a Chilliwack Proper East house add a suite?
faq.a: Under Zoning Bylaw 2020, No. 5000, one accessory dwelling unit per lot — a secondary suite capped at the lesser of 90 m² and 40% of the building's habitable floor space, a coach house, or a garden suite capped at 100 m² — built with a permit meeting the BC Building and Fire Code and flood protection requirements; the SSMUH amendment (Bylaw 5395, adopted June 18, 2024) allows 3 to 4 units on eligible urban-growth-boundary parcels zoned for single-detached and duplex housing.

faq.q: Is Chilliwack Proper East in a floodplain?
faq.a: The guide, citing the Downtown Neighbourhood Plan, says Chilliwack Proper is subject to the flood risk of the Fraser River, the dyke system is built to a 1-in-200-year flood standard, and areas outside the dyking system flood at higher river stages — flood status is set lot by lot, so ask the City about the specific lot.
